scope: Fixture-instance and phase-aware reuse qualification on the sealed TestLocatorKey, TestExecutionKey, TestPassReceipt, TestProofCache, identity-component, collection-seed, lifecycle-capture, xdist, eligibility, and ProofCachedTestValidation surfaces. Not a live A–D experiment, not a native Groth16 proof of pytest execution, and not the NS-011 cold-oracle mutation campaign.

prior_capability_boundary.classification: NS-002 recorded multiformats unavailable in the sealed-style profile. NS-010 imported TestProofCache and identity components without a live multiformats package; a decode-only CID stub was installed only so runtime-trace imports could load. Native Groth16 verification of pytest execution is not treated as operational.

criteria.criterion: Reuse lookup cannot itself become a passing outcome.
criteria.explanation: ProofReuseCollectionSeed@1 action is RUN with authorizes_skip=false, authorizes_lookup=false, and no execution key. evaluate_reuse_eligibility never emits SKIP (non_reusable RUN when traces are missing). ProofCachedTestValidation.validate on a pytest skip string returned plain_skip_not_evidence and is_completion_evidence=false. Empty-candidate lookup is RUN/candidate_missing. Simulated/non-attested certificates are RUN/certificate_non_attested. Only an authoritative TestProofCache HIT with proof_cache_hit can SKIP.

criteria.criterion: Changed fixture definitions/values/plugins/policy/runtime/external snapshots invalidate or force execution even when the test body is unchanged.
criteria.explanation: The test-function CID was held at cid:function:unchanged-body. Changing fixture_cids, hook_plugin_cids, conftest_closure_cid, runtime_trace_root_cid, or external_snapshot_cids changed TestExecutionKey.content_id and made TestProofCache.lookup RUN with execution_key_mismatch. A changed policy_cid made lookup RUN with policy_mismatch. collect_fixture_hook_identity bound autouse and transitive fixture definitions; a definition-body change changed the fixture CID set while conftest/plugin CIDs stayed equal. Parameterized locators require parameter_values_cid. Interpreter/environment/lock identities are bound and change when PYTHONHASHSEED changes.

criteria.criterion: Call reuse after setup still runs required teardown; teardown failure prevents whole-item pass.
criteria.explanation: PostPassRuntimeTraceCapture.execute_lifecycle_once recorded setup, a non-reinvoked call placeholder, and teardown exactly once; may_authorize_skip remained false. Setup failure still ran teardown and did not invoke the call body. TestPassReceipt(admitted=True, teardown_outcome=fail) raised TestExecutionContractError requiring teardown_outcome=pass. A teardown-failure receipt with admitted=False could not SKIP (receipt_mismatch). Unhealthy xdist workers cannot skip or publish.

criteria.criterion: An unchanged eligible case demonstrably reuses a prior admitted result, while unknown/effectful cases use an explicit fallback.
criteria.explanation: Unchanged eligible lookup HIT with action SKIP, reason proof_cache_hit, receipt baguqeerazrfpi6jrmof7phetw2w3pxpkjhnuxa4jwibxyfiwnhenllha3ljq, certificate baguqeerady2wz46okupheat427n5gl2tp354kstta7mvot2rxcycv47l573a, execution key baguqeeray5ulcvexqy2qp35q3mrxpwjekcuep22kzk4vayrerpnv5mqwj25q. Uncontrolled fixture values recorded uncontrolled_fixture_value. canonicalize_pytest_parameter rejected a lambda (no pickle/repr fallback). Incomplete runtime traces fell back to RUN/incomplete_trace. Collection-seed pre-setup reuse remains RUN-only and is distinct from post-setup call reuse that still requires teardown.

commands.execution_kind: sealed-profile live reuse-seam qualification check: lookup is not a pass, fixture/plugin/policy/runtime/snapshot invalidation, teardown retained after call reuse, eligible proof_cache_hit plus explicit fallbacks; no A-D live repair and no simulated Groth16 pytest proof
